records.specification_basis: The period 312/67 specification is described as a five-speed manual. The source describes a manual five-speed; no paddle or sequential control is documented for this 1967 car, so the period manual control is proposed as an H-pattern with medium confidence. An H-pattern manual racing transmission requires a clutch to pull away from rest under the project's derivation rules; the source does not indicate an automated launch system. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Throttle-lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. No automatic blip system is documented for this period manual car; this is a cautious period-control proposal, not a claim that every restored car lacks one.
